In 1946, Ed Barker organized and published the first newsletter for the Track Coaches of Ohio. The purpose was and is to keep the coaches of Ohio informed. The news concerns everything from the inductees into the Hall of Fame, the District Coaches of the year, to athletes who earn National Honors, along with other important information to share within our coaching community. The Runner clinic edition is found here on our website. Quarterly editions are now found on our Facebook Page.
